callsWidgetWindow.cannotStartCall.messag.defaultMessage: There is an in-progress call on another server that must be ended before joining a new call.

label.add.description: Confirm button of the Add Server modal; adds the new server (verb).

label.allow.description: Button in the native permission request dialog that grants the requested permission.

label.deny.description: Button in the native permission request dialog that refuses the requested permission (this time only).

label.no.description: Generic 'No' button label reused in native confirmation dialogs (quit confirmation, unresponsive window, open external protocol).

label.ok.description: Generic 'OK' button label reused in native dialogs (crash report dialog, 'you're up to date' dialog).

label.remove.description: Destructive confirm button of the remove-server confirmation modal; 'Remove' is a verb.

label.yes.description: Generic 'Yes' button label reused in native confirmation dialogs (quit confirmation, unresponsive window, open external protocol).

main.allowProtocolDialog.button.saveProt.description: Dialog button that opens the external link and remembers the protocol as always allowed; {protocol} is a URL scheme such as 'spotify:'.

main.allowProtocolDialog.detail.defaultMessage: The requested link is {URL}. Do you want to continue?

main.allowProtocolDialog.title.description: Title of the native warning dialog shown when a link uses a protocol other than http/https; 'http(s)' is a literal protocol name.

main.app.app.handleAppCertificateError.c.description: Button in the certificate error dialog; aborts connecting to the server.
Button in the certificate error dialog; shows a second dialog with more information about the untrusted certificate.

main.app.utils.clearDataForServer.cancel.description: Cancel button of the confirmation dialog for erasing one server's data.

main.app.utils.clearDataForServer.confir.description: Destructive confirm button of the dialog that erases stored data for a single server; 'Clear' is a verb.

renderer.dropdown.servers.description: Header of the dropdown listing the user's configured Mattermost servers; shown next to a keyboard shortcut.

Empty-state row in the client-certificate selection table when the system has no certificates to offer.
Column header in the client-certificate selection table; the certificate's serial number. Compact space.
Column header in the client-certificate selection table; the entity the certificate was issued to. Compact space.

renderer.modals.login.loginModal.passwor.description: Placeholder text of the password input in the basic-auth login popup shown when a server or proxy requests credentials.

renderer.modals.login.loginModal.usernam.description: Placeholder text of the username input in the basic-auth login popup shown when a server or proxy requests credentials.
